pr.title: Add agent-level and phase-level restart capabilities
pr.description:
Adds force-retry at two levels — individual agents and entire phases —
without killing the whole pipeline. Exposed via REST API, MCP tools,
and overseer auto-restart actions. Fixes #1551.
pr.test_plan:
- Automated: Unit tests for restart endpoints, spawner method, MCP tools, overseer actions
- Automated: Edge case tests for missing pipeline/agent, restart limits, consensus reset
- Manual: Submit a pipeline, manually hang an agent (e.g., large codebase read), trigger restart via MCP tool, verify agent resumes with worktree intact
- Manual: Trigger phase restart, verify all agents respawn and consensus resets
